_doc: Width gate data (docs/windows.md has the evidence per row). Per kind: font (12/8), px = widest line, lines = lines per page (msg) or 1, last_px = last line of a page (page arrow), status measured | jp-bound (box not reached in a tour yet: px = the longest Japanese line of the kind at 12 px, which the box holds; verify in phase 8) | not-drawn (no px: never displayed, e.g. sort keys). Kinds not listed get a 'no budget' warning from tools/lint.py. Byte caps of arm9 slots come from insert.text_cap (max-2, KIND_CAP, engine.RELOC).
